mapper.insert: INSERT INTO library_card (student_id, card_no, issue_date, expire_date, status, create_time, update_time, deleted) VALUES (#{studentId}, #{cardNo}, #{issueDate}, #{expireDate}, #{status}, NOW(), NOW(), 0)
mapper.update: UPDATE library_card SET card_no = #{cardNo}, issue_date = #{issueDate}, expire_date = #{expireDate}, status = #{status}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM library_card WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
SELECT * FROM library_card WHERE student_id = #{studentId} AND deleted = 0

SELECT lc.id, lc.student_id, lc.card_no, lc.issue_date, lc.expire_date, lc.status, lc.create_time, lc.update_time, s.id as s_id, s.name as s_name, s.student_no as s_student_no, s.age as s_age, s.major as s_major FROM library_card lc LEFT JOIN student s ON lc.student_id = s.id AND s.deleted = 0 WHERE lc.id = #{id} AND lc.deleted = 0

SELECT lc.id, lc.student_id, lc.card_no, lc.issue_date, lc.expire_date, lc.status, lc.create_time, lc.update_time, s.id as s_id, s.name as s_name, s.student_no as s_student_no, s.age as s_age, s.major as s_major FROM library_card lc LEFT JOIN student s ON lc.student_id = s.id AND s.deleted = 0 WHERE lc.student_id = #{studentId} AND lc.deleted = 0
SELECT * FROM library_card WHERE deleted = 0 ORDER BY create_time DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM library_card WHERE deleted = 0
